summary: Defines a mechanism for domain owners to tell DNS clients about local resolvers that are authorized to answer for certain names in split-horizon deployments. Clients that do not use that resolver by default can then use it just for those names.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a building has its own phone book for its own names. This lets the owner of a name vouch for that phone book so your device trusts it.

questions: how to trust a local dns resolver for a domain
